Subject: Request: alternate onboarding / invoice-only for Streamlytics pilot

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about Redwood for our initial ETL/embedding pipeline evaluation. We have a small pilot budget and our procurement process at Streamlytics requires a signed PO for standard vendors, which takes 4–6 weeks. That timeline would push us past the window we need to validate this pilot.

Would Redwood consider an invoice-only onboarding path for the pilot (one month of invoicing, net-30) with the caveat that we provide a payment guarantee (credit card on file or corporate ACH) and sign an SOW?

If helpful, I can share Streamlytics’ W9 and a short SOW draft. We are asking for this exception only for the first 90 days; after that we will submit a formal PO if we expand.

Appreciate any flexibility and the steps we should take to make this compliant on your side.

Best,
Ariel Gomez
Head of Data Partnerships
Streamlytics

Karthik / Laura — forwarding a pilot request from Streamlytics. They want a temporary invoice-only onboarding (no PO) for up to 90 days with SOW + payment guarantee.

- Is there an established playbook for a 90-day invoice-only pilot for small pilot commitments?

Marcus — thanks for routing. We do have a lightweight exception path for small pilots but need to be careful about exposure and auditability. Requirements I need to confirm before procurement/finance will approve: 

- Completed Procurement Exception Form (signed by vendor and Redwood sponsor)
- W9 (for US vendors) and company EIN verification
- Signed SOW with clear scope, spend cap, and termination clause
- Payment guarantee: ideally a credit card on file or ACH confirmation. If neither, we need a signed net-30 invoice commitment and escalation contact at the vendor.
- Limit to $20k spend or a shorter duration; any overage must be pre-approved.

If Streamlytics can provide W9 + SOW and sign the exception form, I can approve for up to $15k for 90 days with the Finance visible in the loop (cc Laura). Also will need to open ticket PROC-889 to track the exception and retain evidence.

I’ll draft the exception form and SOW checklist and share back.

-Karthik
